description: A rectangular rug with a vibrant geometric pattern. The main body of the rug is a deep red, adorned with repeating hexagonal motifs. These motifs feature intricate designs in shades of blue, yellow, white, and brown, creating a complex and eye-catching visual. Surrounding the central pattern is a bold border. The inner border consists of a jagged, triangular design in yellow and black and white. Further out, there are thin striped bands in various colors, including red, green, and blue. The rug has tasseled edges in a natural, beige color, adding a soft textural element. The overall design is dense and detailed, suggesting a traditional craftsmanship.
